Cloverdale acreages for sale: houses and land on lots of one acre or more. The Fraser Valley Real Estate Board benchmark for a detached house in Cloverdale was $1,317,200 in September 2026. Jared sets up a search for the size, area and use you want, and checks whether the land is in the ALR before you offer.
Cloverdale houses with acreage sold, November 2025 to October 2026
Fewer than 3 houses with acreage sold in Cloverdale, too few to describe.
When so few sell, one sale is the whole picture, so this page does not quote a typical price. Ask Jared for the recent sales near the address you are looking at.

The benchmark is the board’s modelled price for a typical home of this type, not an average of sales. The index sets January 2005 at 100. Changes are as published; the text below calls a change a rise or fall only at 1.5% or more.

blocks.text: Cloverdale: the detached houses benchmark was $1,317,200 in September 2026. Over the past year it fell 6.9%; over three months it fell 2.7%; over the last month it fell 1.7%. Longer term, over 3 years it fell 11.3%; over 5 years it fell 5.1%.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.
